title: Shop — Service
description: One service end to end: SLO, RED, latency distribution, dependencies, database, saturation, logs and traces.

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, job, deployment, slo) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Shop.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)
list.textFormat: Spot preemption, upgrade or repair: its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="shop"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="shop"})

panels.title: Latency SLI (30d)
panels.description: Share of requests faster than the service latency threshold.

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: 4xx are client or business outcomes (unknown user, payment declined) and do not count against the SLO.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(http_server_requests_total{namespace="shop", job="$service", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (route) (rate(http_server_requests_total{namespace="shop", job="$service"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(http_server_requests_total{namespace="shop", job="$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Slower than the SLO threshold — by route
panels.description: Latency SLI per route: share of requests slower than the service threshold. The dashed line is the 1% the SLO allows; a single slow route shows up here even when the service average looks fine.

targets.expr: clamp_min(1 - histogram_share(scalar(max(slo:sli_threshold:seconds{job="$service", slo="latency"})), sum by (route, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="shop", job="$service"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket; a band moving up means the whole service slowed down, a second band means a slow subset.

panels.title: Outgoing calls by peer and status
panels.description: Calls this service makes to other services (empty for leaf services).

panels.title: Incoming calls by caller
panels.description: Which services call this one, as seen by the callers (api-gateway traffic is not instrumented client-side).

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Connections of each pod's pool (DB_MAX_CONNS). In use at the maximum means requests queue for a connection.

panels.title: Waiting for a connection
panels.description: Acquisitions that found no idle connection and waited (left, per second), how long they waited (right) and how many gave up because the request timed out first.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(pgxpool_empty_acquire_wait_seconds_total{namespace="shop", job="$service"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(pgxpool_empty_acquires_total{namespace="shop", job="$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Sessions in PostgreSQL
panels.description: This service's sessions on the database by state. "idle in transaction" that persists is a transaction left open: it holds locks (ended by PostgreSQL after 30s for the services).

panels.title: PostgreSQL errors by SQLSTATE
panels.description: Errors PostgreSQL logged for this service's sessions: 55P03 lock timeout (another transaction holds the row), 57014 cancelled (statement_timeout, or the service gave up), 23505 duplicate key, 40P01 deadlock. Details in the CloudNativePG dashboard (Queries and errors, Locks and blocking).

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop", kubernetes.container_name="postgres"} record.application_name:in($service) record.error_severity:in(ERROR, FATAL) | stats by (record.sql_state_code) count() errors

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts in the previous 10 minutes (OOMKilled, failed liveness probe, crash).

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="shop"} service:in($service) level:in(WARN, ERROR) | stats by (level, _msg) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 10

panels.title: WARN and ERROR logs — $service
panels.description: Expand a line and follow trace_id to open the trace.

panels.title: Slowest traces
panels.description: Traces through $service slower than the selected minimum duration.

panels.title: Traces with errors
panels.description: Traces through $service with a span marked as error.
